# TapTag.one — Full Corporate & Technical Directory

> TapTag.one is a unified web security, Smart QR, phone extraction, universal file conversion, and Mata AI workspace Built By Matany Group (المطعني جروب) and developed by Mohamed Matany (محمد مطعني).

---

## Corporate & Developer Identity

- **Corporate Umbrella**: Matany Group (المطعني جروب) — Established 2019
- **Corporate Portal**: https://matanygroup.com
- **Corporate Email**: support@matanygroup.com
- **Founder & Lead Developer**: Mohamed Matany (محمد مطعني / محمد أحمد مطعني)
- **Developer Contact**: mo@matany.one

---

## Core Capabilities & Mata AI

1. **AES-256-GCM Encrypted File Share** — Client-side zero-knowledge encryption with PIN & WebAuthn biometrics.
2. **Link & Phone Extractor** — Structured extraction of phone numbers, WhatsApp links, emails, and JSON-LD contacts.
3. **Dynamic Smart QR Studio** — Custom branded QR codes featuring the Mata AI calligraphic emblem (`Kaushan_Script` + vector paths).
4. **Mata AI** — Cross-suite intelligent copilot unifying file auditing, contact structuring, QR generation, and conversion.
5. **All-Format Converter** — Instant client-side and server-side document, spreadsheet, media, and archive conversion.
